entities.name: CTP synthase
observations: The 544-aa query sequence matches reviewed archaeal CTP synthases, with the best hit Q3IS15 at 79.7% identity and 99.6% query coverage; function transfer supports ATP-dependent UTP amination to CTP, EC 6.3.4.2.
Reviewed homolog annotations describe pyrimidine de novo CTP biosynthesis and homotetrameric assembly; these are homology-based assignments for the query, not direct experimental results.
